####process PCA to add gene names to loadings and scale arrows

```{r}

# Ensure gene names exist
if (!"gene_name" %in% colnames(PCA_loadings)) {
  PCA_loadings$gene_name <- rownames(PCA_loadings)
}

# Select top genes by contribution
n_arrows <- 25
loadings2 <- PCA_loadings %>%
  mutate(contrib = PC1^2 + PC2^2) %>%
  slice_max(contrib, n = n_arrows)

# Scale loadings so arrows fit in score space
arrow_scale <- max(abs(c(PCAdata$PC1, PCAdata$PC2)), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9
loadings2 <- loadings2 %>%
  mutate(PC1s = PC1 * arrow_scale,
         PC2s = PC2 * arrow_scale)

# Axis labels with explained variance
pc1_lab <- paste0("PC1 (", scales::percent(pca_res$var_exp[1], accuracy = 0.1), ")")
pc2_lab <- paste0("PC2 (", scales::percent(pca_res$var_exp[2], accuracy = 0.1), ")")

# === Biplot ===
p_biplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = PCAdata,
             aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = name, shape = replicate),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_segment(data = loadings2,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1s, yend = PC2s),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.02, "npc")), linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = loadings2,
                  aes(x = PC1s, y = PC2s, label = gene_name),
                  size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0) +
  labs(x = pc1_lab, y = pc2_lab, title = "PCA biplot (VST, DESeq2)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_biplot)

ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot_deseq2, "_PCA_biplot_loadings_DESeq2.pdf"),
       plot = p_biplot, width = 6.5, height = 5)

ggplot(PCA_loadings, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_text_repel(data = PCA_loadings %>% slice_max(PC1^2 + PC2^2, n = 25),
                  aes(label = gene_name), size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Gene loadings on PC1 and PC2",
       x = "PC1 loading", y = "PC2 loading")
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot_deseq2, "_PCA_loadings_dotplot.pdf"),
       width = 6.5, height = 5)

```
####PCA loading analysis top 50 per PC

```{r}
top_pc1_pos <- PCA_loadings %>% arrange(desc(PC1)) %>% slice_head(n = 50)
top_pc1_neg <- PCA_loadings %>% arrange(PC1) %>% slice_head(n = 50)

top_pc2_pos <- PCA_loadings %>% arrange(desc(PC2)) %>% slice_head(n = 50)
top_pc2_neg <- PCA_loadings %>% arrange(PC2) %>% slice_head(n = 50)

names(gene_ranks_pc1) <- PCA_loadings$gene_name

gene_ranks_pc2 <- PCA_loadings$PC2

###unranked and on top 50

top_pc1_neg_entrez <- bitr(top_pc1_neg$gene_name, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)

top_pc2_neg_entrez <- bitr(top_pc2_neg$gene_name, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)

###entrez lists on ranked lists
```

####run GO enrichment test on top 50 ###PC1

```{r}
# Run enrichment tests (GO or KEGG)
ego_pc1_pos <- enrichGO(gene = top_pc1_pos_entrez$ENTREZID,
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        ont = "BP",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        readable = TRUE)

ego_pc1_neg <- enrichGO(gene = top_pc1_neg_entrez$ENTREZID,
                        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        ont = "BP",
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                        readable = TRUE)

#  Visualize results
library(enrichplot)

dotplot(ego_pc1_pos,showCategory = 15, title = "Top PC1 Positive Loadings (iPSC) – GO BP")
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot_deseq2, "_", "GO_PC1pos.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 12)
dotplot(ego_pc1_neg,showCategory = 15, title = "Top PC1 Negative Loadings (muscle) – GO BP")
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot_deseq2, "_", "GO_PC1neg.pdf"),
     width = 10, height = 12)

# For KEGG instead:
ekegg_pc1_pos <- enrichKEGG(gene = top_pc1_pos_entrez$ENTREZID, organism = "hsa")
ekegg_pc1_neg <- enrichKEGG(gene = top_pc1_neg_entrez$ENTREZID, organism = "hsa")

dotplot(ekegg_pc1_pos, showCategory = 15, title = "KEGG enrichment (PC1 positive)")
```

####GSEA on PC1 and PC2

```{r}

# Rank all genes by PC1 loading
gene_ranks_pc2 <- PCA_loadings$PC1
names(gene_ranks_pc2) <- PCA_loadings$gene_name

                              toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)
gene_ranks_pc2 <- gene_ranks_pc1[match(gene_ranks_pc2_entrez$SYMBOL, names(gene_ranks_pc2))]
names(gene_ranks_pc2) <- gene_ranks_pc2_entrez$ENTREZID

# Run GSEA
gsea_pc2 <- gseGO(geneList = sort(gene_ranks_pc2, decreasing = TRUE),
```

####make plots for specific genes by Deseq2 data normalized

```{r}

geneInfo_f <- geneInfo_f %>%
  mutate(gene_name = ifelse(
    gene_ID == "MYOD1",          # the custom one you added
    "MYOD1exo",                  # rename it
    gene_name                    # keep all others unchanged
  ))

genes_to_plot=c("MYOG","TTN","IGF2","DLK1","MYL2","POU5F1","NANOG","NANOGxt","MYOD1","MYOC","MYOD1exo","NR3C1","NR3C2")
g_info_plot=geneInfo_f[ geneInfo_f$gene_name %in% genes_to_plot , c("gene_ID","gene_name") ]
genes_to_plot_ensb=g_info_plot$gene_ID

#dd <- plotCounts(dds, gene=c("ENSG00000122180"), intgroup=c("condition","name","replicate","name_R"), returnData=TRUE)
#gene_symbol <- geneInfo_f$gene_name[ geneInfo_f$gene_ID == "ENSG00000122180" ]
#colnames(dd)[ colnames(dd) == "count" ] <- gene_symbol

intgroup      <- c("condition","name","replicate","name_R","cell_type")

# helper: match Ensembl (with or w/o version) to row index in dds
ens_dds_raw    <- rownames(dds)
ens_dds_novers <- sub("\\..*$","", ens_dds_raw)
get_idx <- function(ens_id) {
  key <- sub("\\..*$","", ens_id)
  idx <- which(ens_dds_novers == key)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(integer(0))
  if (length(idx) == 1) return(idx)
  # if multiple rows, pick the most expressed by total normalized counts
  nc <- counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)[idx, , drop=FALSE]
  idx[ which.max(rowSums(nc, na.rm=TRUE)) ]
}

# build one small dd per gene, keep only keys + this gene's counts (renamed)
dd_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(g_info_plot)), function(i) {
  ens  <- g_info_plot$gene_ID[i]
  sym  <- g_info_plot$gene_name[i]
  idx  <- get_idx(ens)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)  # silently skip if not found in dds
  dd_i <- plotCounts(dds, gene = idx, intgroup = intgroup, normalized=TRUE
,returnData = TRUE)
  colnames(dd_i)[ colnames(dd_i) == "count" ] <- sym
  # keep only join keys + this gene column
  dd_i[, c(intgroup, sym), drop=FALSE]
})

# drop missing
dd_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), dd_list)
if (length(dd_list) == 0) stop("None of the requested genes were found in 'dds'.")

# merge all by the requested columns
dd_merged <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = intgroup, all = TRUE), dd_list)

#dd_merged=dd_merged[dd_merged$name!="hiPSC", ]


ggplot(dd_merged, aes(x = cell_type, y = MYOG)) +
  # Boxplot: same box per cell type (no grouping by condition)
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
  # Jitter: condition affects shape and color
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = condition, color = name), width = 0.2, size = 2) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("GERALT", "OPTIOX")),  # replace with your levels
              map_signif_level = TRUE,
              test = "wilcox.test")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
  labs(
    title = "MYOG expression by cell type and condition",
    y = "DESeq2 normalized counts (log1p)",
    x = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave(filename = paste0(fname_prefix_gene_deseq2, "_MYOG.pdf"),
       width = 6.5, height = 5)

# Loop through each gene
for (gene in genes_to_plot) {

  # Skip if gene column not present
  if (!(gene %in% colnames(dd_merged))) {
    message("Skipping ", gene, " (not found in dd_merged)")
    next
  }

  # Build the plot
  p <- ggplot(dd_merged, aes(x = cell_type, y = .data[[gene]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
    geom_jitter(aes(shape = condition, color = name), width = 0.2, size = 2) +
      geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("GERALT", "OPTIOX")),  # replace with your levels
              map_signif_level = TRUE,
              test = "wilcox.test")+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(gene, " expression by cell type and condition"),
      y = "DESeq2 normalized counts (log1p)",
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  # Save each plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_gene_deseq2, "_", gene, ".pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5, height = 5
  )

  message("Saved plot for ", gene)
}

```

####make plots for specific genes by TPM data normalized

```{r}

geneInfo_f <- geneInfo_f %>%
  mutate(gene_name = ifelse(
    gene_ID == "MYOD1",          # the custom one you added
    "MYOD1exo",                  # rename it
    gene_name                    # keep all others unchanged
  ))

genes_to_plot=c("MYOG","TTN","IGF2","DLK1","MYL2","POU5F1","NANOG","NANOGxt","MYOD1","MYOC","MYOD1exo","NR3C1","NR3C2")
g_info_plot=geneInfo_f[ geneInfo_f$gene_name %in% genes_to_plot , c("gene_ID","gene_name") ]
genes_to_plot_ensb=g_info_plot$gene_ID

filter_tpm=counts_tpm[ rownames(counts_tpm) %in% genes_to_plot_ensb , ]
filter_tpm$ensb=rownames(filter_tpm)
filter_tpm=filter_tpm%>%
  left_join(g_info_plot, by=c("ensb"="gene_ID"))
rownames(filter_tpm)=filter_tpm$gene_name
filter_tpm=filter_tpm%>%
  select(-ensb, -gene_name)

m=as.data.frame(t(filter_tpm))
m$sample_ID=rownames(m)
m=m%>%
  left_join(meta, by="sample_ID")
rownames(m)=m$sample_ID

#m=m[ m$name!="hiPSC", ]#take off the hiPSC

# Loop through each gene
for (gene in genes_to_plot) {

  # Skip if gene column not present
  if (!(gene %in% colnames(m))) {
    message("Skipping ", gene, " (not found in m)")
    next
  }

  # Build the plot
  p <- ggplot(m, aes(x = cell_type, y = .data[[gene]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
    geom_jitter(aes(shape = condition, color = name), width = 0.2, size = 2) +
      geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("GERALT", "OPTIOX")),  # replace with your levels
              map_signif_level = TRUE,
              test = "wilcox.test")+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(gene, " expression by cell type and condition"),
      y = "TPM normalized counts (log1p)",
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  # Save each plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_gene_deseq2, "_", gene, "_TPM.pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5, height = 5
  )

  message("Saved plot for ", gene)
}
```

```{r}
  # Build the plot
  p <- ggplot(m, aes(x = cell_type, y = .data[[gene]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
    geom_jitter(aes(shape = condition, color = name), width = 0.2, size = 2) +
      geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("GERALT", "OPTIOX")),  # replace with your levels
              map_signif_level = TRUE,
              test = "wilcox.test")+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(gene, " expression by cell type and condition"),
      y = "TPM normalized counts (ln(TPM + 1))",
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  # Save each plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_gene_deseq2, "_", gene, "_TPM.pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5, height = 5
  )

  message("Saved plot for ", gene)
}

```

####create Meta data with contrasts for DEG analysis

```{r}
# Create contrast columns for each condition comparison
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX = ifelse(cell_type == "GERALT", "GERALT",
                                     ifelse(cell_type == "OPTIOX"&condition !="hiPSCs", "OPTIOX", "no")),
         cfr_TT2MN_vs_TMM = ifelse(name == "TT2MN", "TT2MN",
                                     ifelse(name == "TMM", "TMM", "no")),
         cfr_TT2MNb_vs_TMM = ifelse(name == "TT2MNb", "TT2MNb",
                                     ifelse(name == "TMM", "TMM", "no")),
         cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM = ifelse(name == "TT2MNi", "TT2MNi",
                                     ifelse(name == "TMM", "TMM", "no")),
         cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb = ifelse(name == "TT2MN", "TT2MN",
                                     ifelse(name == "TT2MNb", "TT2MNb", "no")),
         cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNi = ifelse(name == "TT2MN", "TT2MN",
                                     ifelse(name == "TT2MNi", "TT2MNi", "no")),
         cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb = ifelse(name == "TT2MNi", "TT2MNi",
                                     ifelse(name == "TT2MNb", "TT2MNb", "no")))
```


####DEG analysis between GERALT and OPTIOX for each cell type one by one then do a loop

```{r}
#In meta I already placed my contrast columns starting with "cfr_"
#in case cfr_columns do not exist just create them. Place in the comparison the condition name (meta$condition relative to the sample) and the samples not analyzed will have "no" instead.
# Identify contrast columns (those starting with "cfr_")
contrast_cols <- grep("^cfr_", colnames(meta), value = TRUE)
contrast_cols
# Pick one contrast manually for now (first one)
contrast_col <- contrast_cols[12]#GERALT vs OPTIOX column (need to check the contrast col)
contrast_col

# Prepare metadata for this contrast
meta_cfr <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_ID, condition, replicate, !!sym(contrast_col)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cfr = !!sym(contrast_col)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cfr != "no")

# Subset DESeq2 object to relevant samples
dds_sub <- dds[, colnames(dds) %in% meta_cfr$sample_ID]
dds_sub$group <- factor(meta_cfr$cfr)
#levels(dds_sub$group) #check level of contrast
# (Optional — set whichever condition you want as baseline)
dds_sub$group <- relevel(dds_sub$group, ref = levels(dds_sub$group)[1])
# --- Define new design formula ---
design(dds_sub) <- ~ group
# Run DESeq2
dds_sub <- DESeq(dds_sub)

# Define contrast (2 levels only)
cfr_levels <- levels(dds_sub$group)
res <- results(dds_sub, contrast = c("group", cfr_levels[1], cfr_levels[2]))

# Clean result table
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df <- res_df %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_ID") %>%
  left_join(geneInfo_f, by = "gene_ID") %>%
  arrange(padj)

res_df=res_df%>%dplyr::filter(!gene_ID %in% c("COM_K", "dCAS9","MCP_PH_TagBFP","OPTetR"))#eliminate gene names not needed
#gene_ID=counts_df$gene_ID

```
####create a table to store all the data on specific comparisons

```{r}
###set the comparisons you want to do

comparisons=c("cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX",
              "cfr_TT2MN_vs_TMM",
              "cfr_TT2MNb_vs_TMM",
              "cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TMM",
              "cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNb",
              "cfr_TT2MN_vs_TT2MNi",
              "cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb")

first_to_compare=c("GERALT","TT2MN","TT2MNb","TT2MNi","TT2MN","TT2MN","TT2MNi")

###create an empty list to store all the DEG results
deg_results_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(comparisons)) {
  contrast_col <- comparisons[i]
  ref_level    <- first_to_compare[i]
  message("Processing contrast: ", contrast_col, "  (reference = ", ref_level, ")")

  meta_cfr <- meta %>%
    dplyr::select(sample_ID, condition, replicate, !!sym(contrast_col)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(cfr = !!sym(contrast_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(cfr != "no")

  dds_sub <- dds[, colnames(dds) %in% meta_cfr$sample_ID]
  dds_sub$group <- factor(meta_cfr$cfr)

  # relevel to make sure first_to_compare is the reference
  if (ref_level %in% levels(dds_sub$group)) {
    dds_sub$group <- relevel(dds_sub$group, ref = ref_level)
  } else {
    warning("Reference ", ref_level, " not found in ", contrast_col)
  }

  design(dds_sub) <- ~ group
  dds_sub <- DESeq(dds_sub)

  # contrast = "comparison vs baseline"
  cfr_levels <- levels(dds_sub$group)
  res <- results(dds_sub, contrast = c("group", cfr_levels[1], cfr_levels[2]))

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_ID") %>%
    left_join(geneInfo_f, by = "gene_ID") %>%
    arrange(padj)

  deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] <- res_df
}

# --- user-defined thresholds --- add directionality
fc_cutoff <- log2(2)   # change as needed, e.g. log2(2) for 2× fold change
padj_cutoff <- 0.05      # adjust significance threshold

# --- refine and label each DEG table ---
for (contrast_col in comparisons) {
  message("Processing contrast for final table: ", contrast_col)
  
  deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] <- deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] %>%
   # dplyr::filter(!gene_ID %in% c("COM_K", "dCAS9","MCP_PH_TagBFP","OPTetR"))%>%#eliminate gene names not needed
    dplyr::select(gene_ID, gene_name, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = case_when(
        padj < padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange >  fc_cutoff ~ "Up",
        padj < padj_cutoff & log2FoldChange < -fc_cutoff ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    ) 
}

deg_results_list_preprocessed=deg_results_list
#make a dataframe with all the results

# --- user-defined thresholds ---
fc_cutoff <- log2(2)   # change as needed, e.g. log2(2) for 2× fold change
padj_cutoff <- 0.05      # adjust significance threshold

# --- refine and label each DEG table ---
for (contrast_col in comparisons) {
  message("Processing contrast for final table: ", contrast_col)
  
  deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] <- deg_results_list[[contrast_col]] %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_ID, gene_name, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj, direction) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!paste0(contrast_col, "_log2FC") := log2FoldChange,
      !!paste0(contrast_col, "_pvalue") := pvalue,
      !!paste0(contrast_col, "_padj")   := padj,
      !!paste0(contrast_col, "_direction") := direction
    )
}

library(purrr)
# --- merge all contrasts into one big table ---
deg_merged <- purrr::reduce(deg_results_list, full_join, by = c("gene_ID", "gene_name"))
de_stats <- deg_merged

#save as txt and RDS
filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_DEG_all_comparisons_cfr.txt")
write.table(deg_merged, file=filename, sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F)

Rdata_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_R_deseq2, "_DEG_analysis.RData")
save(deseq_counts,geneInfo_f,counts_f,meta,dds,counts_tpm,deg_results_list,deg_merged,deg_results_list_preprocessed,
     file = Rdata_filename)

```

####calculate nb of DEGs per comparison

```{r}
# Extract only the *_direction columns
direction_cols <- grep("_direction$", colnames(deg_merged), value = TRUE)

# Build a long-format table (gene_ID, gene_name, comparison, direction)
deg_long <- deg_merged %>%
  select(gene_ID, gene_name, all_of(direction_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(direction_cols),
    names_to = "comparison",
    values_to = "direction"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # clean comparison name (remove "_direction" suffix)
    comparison = str_remove(comparison, "_direction$")
  )

# Count Up / Down / NS per comparison
deg_summary <- deg_long %>%
  group_by(comparison, direction) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # optional: pivot wider to have separate columns for Up/Down/NS
  pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = n_genes, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(comparison)

print(deg_summary)

write.table(
```

```{r}
  "cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb"  = genes_cfr_TT2MNi_vs_TT2MNb

# Ensure each element is a named numeric vector (values = logFC, names = SYMBOL)
stopifnot(all(sapply(gene_sets_GSEA, function(x) is.numeric(x) && !is.null(names(x)))))

# Map SYMBOL -> ENTREZ, then rebuild ranked vectors in ENTREZ space
symbol_to_entrez <- suppressMessages(bitr(
  unique(unlist(lapply(gene_sets_GSEA, names))),
  fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db
))

gsea_list   <- list()
GSEA_tables <- list()

for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  ranks_sym <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]

  # join to map to ENTREZ
  df <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ranks_sym), rank = as.numeric(ranks_sym))
  df2 <- merge(df, symbol_to_entrez, by="SYMBOL")
  if (!nrow(df2)) next

  # deduplicate ENTREZ if necessary (keep max |rank|)
  df2 <- df2[order(-abs(df2$rank)), ]
  df2 <- df2[!duplicated(df2$ENTREZID), ]

  ranks_entrez <- df2$rank
  names(ranks_entrez) <- df2$ENTREZID
  ranks_entrez <- sort(ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)

  gsea <- gseGO(geneList      = ranks_entrez,
                OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType       = "ENTREZID",
                ont           = "BP",
                minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,#place this automatic
                maxGSSize     = 500,
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff  = 1,
                nPermSimple = 10000,# readable=TRUE,
                verbose       = FALSE, by = "fgsea")
  
gsea_readable <- setReadable(gsea, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

  gsea_list[[nm]]   <- gsea
  GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_readable)
}

# filter significant terms
# Make a new list of GSEA results filtered by significance
gsea_sig_list <- lapply(gsea_list, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)
  df <- gsea_obj@result
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  
  # filter by adjusted p-value < 0.05
  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  
  # replace the result slot with filtered df
  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

# 1) Write every GO table to CSV: GO_<name>.csv
if (length(GSEA_tables)) {
  for (nm in names(GSEA_tables)) {
    if (is.null(GSEA_tables[[nm]]) || !nrow(GSEA_tables[[nm]])) next
    # file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(fname_prefix_GO, "_GO_", nm, ".csv"))
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_GSEA_DEG_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(GSEA_tables[[nm]], file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

# Helper: save ggplot if it exists
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w=8, h=10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

# Make a dotplot per GSEA result in gsea_list
plot_gsea_dotplots <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10, width=8, height=6) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    # Skip NULL or empty results
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }

    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))

    # GSEA-friendly dotplot: split by .sign for up/down, order by NES
    p <- tryCatch(
      dotplot(g, showCategory = k, split = ".sign", orderBy = "NES") +
        facet_grid(. ~ .sign),
      error = function(e) { message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message); NULL }
    )

    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_GSEA_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots(gsea_list, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2, show_k = 10)


# Vector of target GO IDs ###ID studied before

# Function: loop through GO IDs for a given contrast
save_gsea_plots <- function(gsea_res, contrast_name, go_ids, prefix, width=8, height=6) {
  for (go_id in go_ids) {
    if (go_id %in% gsea_res@result$ID) {
      p <- gseaplot2(gsea_res, geneSetID = go_id, title = go_id)
      out_file <- paste0(prefix, "_", contrast_name, "_", gsub(":", "-", go_id), ".pdf")
      ggsave(out_file, plot = p, width = width, height = height)
      message("Saved: ", out_file)
    } else {
      message("GO term ", go_id, " not found in ", contrast_name)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  message("Running custom GSEA for: ", nm)
  
  # Extract ranked genes (log2FC values)
  gene_ranks <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]
  gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # Run clusterProfiler::GSEA on your custom gene sets
  gsea_custom <- tryCatch({
    GSEA(
      geneList      = gene_ranks,
      TERM2GENE     = term2gene,
      minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,
      maxGSSize     = 500,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = p_cutoff,
      verbose       = FALSE,
      seed          = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error in ", nm, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
  
  if (is.null(gsea_custom) || nrow(as.data.frame(gsea_custom)) == 0) {
    message("No enrichment found for ", nm)
    next
  }
  
  # Save objects
  gsea_list_custom[[nm]]   <- gsea_custom
  GSEA_tables_custom[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_custom)
}

# --- Filter significant results (adjusted p < 0.05) ---
gsea_sig_list_custom <- lapply(gsea_list_custom, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)
  df <- gsea_obj@result
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

# --- Write GSEA tables to CSV ---
if (length(GSEA_tables_custom)) {
  for (nm in names(GSEA_tables_custom)) {
    df <- GSEA_tables_custom[[nm]]
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) next
    
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv_deseq2, "_CustomGSEA_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(df, file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

# --- Helper function to save plots ---
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w = 8, h = 10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

# --- Generate dotplots for each comparison ---
plot_gsea_dotplots_custom <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10, width = 8, height = 6) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    
    # Safely convert to data frame
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }
    
    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))
    
    # --- FIXED: added missing closing parenthesis and split handling ---
    p <- tryCatch({
      dotplot(
        g,
        showCategory = k,
        split = ".sign",
        orderBy = "NES",
        title = paste0("Custom GSEA: ", nm)
      ) + facet_grid(. ~ .sign)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
    
    # Save PDF
    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_CustomGSEA_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots_custom(gsea_list_custom, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2, show_k = 10)

# --- Save the workspace for reproducibility ---
Rdata_filename <- paste0(fname_prefix_gene_GO_deseq2, "_CustomGSEA_analysis.RData")
save(gsea_list_custom, GSEA_tables_custom, gsea_sig_list_custom, gs, term2gene, file = Rdata_filename)
message("Saved RData: ", Rdata_filename)
```

###make volcano plot by showing a gene signature
#GERALT vs OPTIOX

```{r}
# define the signature genes to label
my_signature <- gs$glycolytic_fast  # example gene set

# prepare the data
deg_df <- deg_results_list_preprocessed$cfr_GERALT_vs_OPTIOX

# define thresholds
fc_cutoff <- log2(2)
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

# filter to keep only genes that are significant and in the signature
sig_in_data <- deg_df %>%
  filter(
    gene_name %in% my_signature &
      padj < padj_cutoff &
      abs(log2FoldChange) > fc_cutoff
  ) %>%
  pull(gene_name)

# color palette (same as before)
ok_pal <- c("Up" = "#CC79A7", "Down" = "#009E73", "NS" = "grey70")

# volcano plot
EnhancedVolcano(
  deg_df,
  lab = deg_df$gene_name,
  x = "log2FoldChange",
  y = "padj",
  pCutoff = padj_cutoff,
  FCcutoff = fc_cutoff,
  title = "GERALT vs OPTIOX",
  subtitle = "Volcano Plot: glycolytic fast signature genes",
  caption = "Cutoff: padj < 0.05 & |log2FC| > 1",
  pointSize = 2.0,
  colCustom = ok_pal[deg_df$direction],
  colAlpha = 0.5,
  drawConnectors = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.3,
  colConnectors = "black",
  boxedLabels = TRUE,
  labSize = 2.5,
  max.overlaps = 50,
  # --- highlight only your signature *and significant* genes ---
  selectLab = sig_in_data,
  legendLabSize = 10,
  legendIconSize = 3.5,
  borderWidth = 0.6,
  axisLabSize = 12
) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -10,
    y = max(-log10(deg_df$padj), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
    label = "TMM",
    hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", colour = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 10,
    y = max(-log10(deg_df$padj), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
    label = "TT2MN types",
    hjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold", colour = "black"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(fname_prefix_volcano_deseq2, "_GERALT_OPTIOX_glycolytic_fast_sigOnly.pdf"),
  width = 6, height = 7
)
```

####add directions

```{r}
#Set the significance level cutoff
sig_level <- 0.01
#Set a fold-change cutoff
fc_level <- log2(2)
fc_level2 <- (log2(2))*-1
###################################
N=20
list=c("1vs2","4vs3","3vsall","4vsall")

for (i in list) {
  cluster_name <- paste0("clust", i)
  
  # Create column names dynamically
  logFC_col <- paste0("logFC_", i)
  q_value_col <- paste0("q_value_", i)
  treshold_col <- paste0("treshold_cl", i)
  Log10pvalue_col <- paste0("Log10pvalue_cl", i)
  
  # Apply thresholding logic
  de_stats[[treshold_col]] <- ifelse(de_stats[[logFC_col]] >= fc_level & de_stats[[q_value_col]] <= sig_level, "up",
                                      ifelse(de_stats[[logFC_col]] <= fc_level2 & de_stats[[q_value_col]] <= sig_level, "down", "other"))
  
  de_stats[[Log10pvalue_col]] <- -log10(de_stats[[q_value_col]]+1e-305)
}

N <- 25
contrasts <- c("1vs2","4vs3","3vsall","4vsall")

for (i in contrasts) {
  logFC_col       <- paste0("logFC_", i)
  q_value_col     <- paste0("q_value_", i)
  Log10pvalue_col <- paste0("Log10pvalue_cl", i)
  to_show_col     <- paste0("to_show_cl", i)

  # ensure -log10(p) column exists
  de_stats[[Log10pvalue_col]] <- -log10(de_stats[[q_value_col]] + 1e-305)

  # boolean masks
  up_idx   <- de_stats[[logFC_col]] >=  fc_level & de_stats[[q_value_col]] <= sig_level
  down_idx <- de_stats[[logFC_col]] <= fc_level2 & de_stats[[q_value_col]] <= sig_level

  # pick top N in each set by significance
  up_top   <- order(de_stats[[Log10pvalue_col]], decreasing = TRUE)[up_idx][seq_len(min(N, sum(up_idx)))]
  down_top <- order(de_stats[[Log10pvalue_col]], decreasing = TRUE)[down_idx][seq_len(min(N, sum(down_idx)))]

  # vector of which rows to show
  show_idx <- logical(nrow(de_stats))
  show_idx[up_top] <- TRUE
  show_idx[down_top] <- TRUE

  # NEW COLUMN: gene name if in top/bottom set, "" otherwise
  de_stats[[to_show_col]] <- ifelse(show_idx, de_stats$geneID, "")
}
stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_gene_reg_with_directions.csv")
write.csv(de_stats, stat_filename, quote = F, row.names = T, sep=",")

###########
de_stats=de_stats%>% distinct(geneID, .keep_all = TRUE)#eliminate duplicates

# Loop through clusters to make all the volcano plots in bulk than use the one below to make specific ones
contrasts <- c("1vs2","4vs3","3vsall","4vsall")

for (i in contrasts)  {
  logFC_col <- paste0("logFC_", i)
  treshold_col <- paste0("treshold_cl", i)
  Log10pvalue_col <- paste0("Log10pvalue_cl", i)

    geom_point(aes(colour = as.factor(!!rlang::sym(treshold_col))), size = 1.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("up" = "red", "down" = "blue", "other" = "grey")) +
     ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
```

```{r}
genes <- genes_1vs2$logFC_1vs2
names(genes) <- genes_1vs2$geneID
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)
genes_1vs2=genes

genes <- genes_4vs3$logFC_4vs3
names(genes) <- genes_4vs3$geneID
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = T)
genes_4vs3=genes

genes <- genes_3vsall$logFC_3vsall
names(genes) <- genes_3vsall$geneID
genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = T)

genes <- genes_4vsall$logFC_4vsall

gene_sets_GSEA <- list(
  "1vs2"    = genes_1vs2,
  "4vs3"    = genes_4vs3,
  "3vsall"  = genes_3vsall,
  "4vsall"  = genes_4vsall
)

# Ensure each element is a named numeric vector (values = logFC, names = SYMBOL)
stopifnot(all(sapply(gene_sets_GSEA, function(x) is.numeric(x) && !is.null(names(x)))))

# Map SYMBOL -> ENTREZ, then rebuild ranked vectors in ENTREZ space
symbol_to_entrez <- suppressMessages(bitr(
  unique(unlist(lapply(gene_sets_GSEA, names))),
  fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db
))

gsea_list   <- list()
GSEA_tables <- list()

for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  ranks_sym <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]

  # join to map to ENTREZ
  df <- data.frame(SYMBOL = names(ranks_sym), rank = as.numeric(ranks_sym))
  df2 <- merge(df, symbol_to_entrez, by="SYMBOL")
  if (!nrow(df2)) next

  # deduplicate ENTREZ if necessary (keep max |rank|)
  df2 <- df2[order(-abs(df2$rank)), ]
  df2 <- df2[!duplicated(df2$ENTREZID), ]

  ranks_entrez <- df2$rank
  names(ranks_entrez) <- df2$ENTREZID
  ranks_entrez <- sort(ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)

  gsea <- gseGO(geneList      = ranks_entrez,
                OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                keyType       = "ENTREZID",
                ont           = "BP",
                minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,#place this automatic
                maxGSSize     = 500,
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff  = 1,
                nPermSimple = 10000,# readable=TRUE,
                verbose       = FALSE, by = "fgsea")
  
gsea_readable <- setReadable(gsea, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

  gsea_list[[nm]]   <- gsea
  GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_readable)
}

# filter significant terms
# Make a new list of GSEA results filtered by significance
gsea_sig_list <- lapply(gsea_list, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)
  df <- gsea_obj@result
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  
  # filter by adjusted p-value < 0.05
  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  
  # replace the result slot with filtered df
  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

# 1) Write every GO table to CSV: GO_<name>.csv
if (length(GSEA_tables)) {
  for (nm in names(GSEA_tables)) {
    if (is.null(GSEA_tables[[nm]]) || !nrow(GSEA_tables[[nm]])) next
    # file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(fname_prefix_GO, "_GO_", nm, ".csv"))
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_GSEA_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(GSEA_tables[[nm]], file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

# Helper: save ggplot if it exists
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w=8, h=10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

# Make a dotplot per GSEA result in gsea_list
plot_gsea_dotplots <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10, width=8, height=10) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    # Skip NULL or empty results
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }

    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))

    # GSEA-friendly dotplot: split by .sign for up/down, order by NES
    p <- tryCatch(
      dotplot(g, showCategory = k, split = ".sign", orderBy = "NES") +
        facet_grid(. ~ .sign),
      error = function(e) { message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message); NULL }
    )

    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_GSEA_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots(gsea_list, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_GO, show_k = 15)

# Function: loop through GO IDs for a given contrast
save_gsea_plots <- function(gsea_res, contrast_name, go_ids, prefix, width=8, height=6) {
  for (go_id in go_ids) {
    if (go_id %in% gsea_res@result$ID) {
      p <- gseaplot2(gsea_res, geneSetID = go_id, title = go_id)
      out_file <- paste0(prefix, "_", contrast_name, "_", gsub(":", "-", go_id), ".pdf")
      ggsave(out_file, plot = p, width = width, height = height)
      message("Saved: ", out_file)
    } else {
      message("GO term ", go_id, " not found in ", contrast_name)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
fix_features <- function(object, genes) {
  present <- intersect(genes, rownames(object))
  if (length(present) == 0L) warning("No genes found from set: ", paste(head(genes, 5), collapse=", "))
  present
}

# Compute module scores for every set in `gs`
for (nm in names(gs)) {
  feats <- fix_features(seurat_AB013, gs[[nm]])
  # skip empty sets
  if (length(feats) == 0L) next
  seurat_AB013 <- AddModuleScore(
    object   = seurat_AB013,
    features = list(feats),        # one set at a time
    name     = paste0(nm, "_score")# Seurat will append "1"
  )
  # Move the created column <name>1 into a clean column <name>
  raw_col <- paste0(nm, "_score1")
  if (raw_col %in% colnames(seurat_AB013@meta.data)) {
    seurat_AB013@meta.data[[nm]] <- seurat_AB013@meta.data[[raw_col]]
    # optional: drop the generated column
    seurat_AB013@meta.data[[raw_col]] <- NULL
  }
}

for (nm in names(gs)) {
  if (nm %in% colnames(seurat_AB013@meta.data)) {
    vec <- seurat_AB013@meta.data[common_cells, nm, drop=TRUE]
    colData(cds)[common_cells, nm] <- vec
  }
}
```

```{r}
## 2) Cluster 1 vs not, in M8 vs E8
#tab_M8 <- table(
 # cluster1 = meta_to_use$monocle_clusters == clust_id,

#fisher_M8 <- fisher.test(tab_M8)
#fisher_M8

clusters <- 1:4

# Build a 2x2 for a cluster vs {E8, test_medium}
build_tab <- function(meta, cl, test_medium) {
  df <- meta %>% filter(medium %in% c("E8", test_medium)) %>%
    mutate(in_cluster = monocle_clusters == cl,
           medium = factor(medium, levels = c("E8", test_medium)))
  tab <- table(df$in_cluster, df$medium)
  list(df = df, tab = tab)
}

safe_fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < .Machine$double.xmin, "< 2.2e-16",
                                 formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 3))

run_tests_one <- function(meta, cl, test_medium) {
  bt <- build_tab(meta, cl, test_medium); df <- bt$df; tab <- bt$tab

  # Counts for prop.test
  succ <- c(tab["TRUE","E8"], tab["TRUE", test_medium])
  tot  <- c(colSums(tab)[["E8"]], colSums(tab)[[test_medium]])

  # 1) Fisher (exact)
  fis <- fisher.test(tab)
  fis_or <- unname(fis$estimate); fis_ci <- fis$conf.int

  # 2) Two-proportion test
  pt  <- prop.test(succ, tot, correct = TRUE)

  # 3) Chi-square (same as prop.test under the hood for 2x2)
  chi <- chisq.test(tab, correct = TRUE)

  # 4) Logistic regression
  glm_fit <- glm(in_cluster ~ medium, family = binomial(), data = df)
  bn <- paste0("medium", test_medium)
  glm_beta <- coef(glm_fit)[bn]
  glm_or   <- unname(exp(glm_beta))
  glm_ci   <- suppressMessages(exp(confint(glm_fit)[bn, ]))
  glm_p    <- summary(glm_fit)$coef[bn, "Pr(>|z|)"]

  tibble(
    medium     = test_medium,
    cluster    = cl,
    n_E8       = tot[1], n_test = tot[2],
    prop_E8    = succ[1]/tot[1], prop_test = succ[2]/tot[2],

    fisher_p   = fis$p.value,
    fisher_p_fmt = safe_fmt_p(fis$p.value),
    fisher_or  = fis_or,
    fisher_ci_low = fis_ci[1], fisher_ci_high = fis_ci[2],

    prop_p     = pt$p.value,
    prop_p_fmt = safe_fmt_p(pt$p.value),

    chisq_p    = chi$p.value,
    chisq_p_fmt= safe_fmt_p(chi$p.value),

    glm_p      = glm_p,
    glm_p_fmt  = safe_fmt_p(glm_p),
    glm_or     = glm_or,
    glm_ci_low = glm_ci[1], glm_ci_high = glm_ci[2]
  )
}

# Run for B8 and M8
res_B8 <- bind_rows(lapply(clusters, run_tests_one, meta = meta_to_use, test_medium = "B8"))
res_M8 <- bind_rows(lapply(clusters, run_tests_one, meta = meta_to_use, test_medium = "M8"))

         prop_padj   = p.adjust(prop_p,   method = "BH"),

         fisher_padj_fmt = safe_fmt_p(fisher_padj),
```

```{r}
stats_t_test <- m_sample_id %>%

stats_anova <- m_sample_id %>%
  filter(medium %in% c("E8","B8","M8")) %>%
  mutate(medium = factor(medium, levels = c("E8","B8","M8"))) %>%  # E8 = control
  group_by(assigned_cell_type_short) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x
    fit <- lm(frxn ~ medium, data = d)
    em  <- emmeans(fit, "medium")
    cmp <- contrast(em, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1)   # B8–E8, M8–E8
    out <- as.data.frame(summary(cmp, infer = TRUE, adjust = "dunnett"))
    # out has: contrast, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value, lower.CL, upper.CL
    tibble(
      contrast = out$contrast,
      estimate = out$estimate,
      SE       = out$SE,
      df       = out$df,
      t.ratio  = out$t.ratio,
      p        = out$p.value,
      p.adj.method = "Dunnett",
      sig=case_when(
        p <= 0.001 ~ "***",
        p <= 0.01  ~ "**",
        p <= 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE       ~ "ns"
      )
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

#Pseudobulk DE: cluster 1 vs cluster 2 (replicated by sample)

##failure

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)

seurat <- seurat_AB013
Idents(seurat) <- "monocle_clusters"          
# replace 'sampleID' below with the metadata column that identifies samples/donors
stopifnot("sample_id" %in% colnames(seurat@meta.data))

# 1) Build a stable grouping key sample×cluster
seurat$pb_group <- interaction(seurat$sample_id,
                               seurat$monocle_clusters,
                               sep = "___", drop = TRUE)

# 2) Aggregate raw counts inside Seurat (sum per sample×cluster)
agg <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat,
  assays = "originalexp",
  slot   = "counts",
  group.by = "pb_group",
  fun    = "sum"
)
pb_counts <- agg$originalexp   # genes x (sample×cluster) matrix

# Split names: everything before the last dash = sample_id, last part = cluster
parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(colnames(pb_counts), "---", fixed = TRUE))

pb_meta <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(pb_counts),
  sample_id = apply(parts[, -ncol(parts), drop = FALSE], 1, paste, collapse = "-"),
  cluster   = parts[, ncol(parts)],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 4) Keep only cluster 1 and 2 pseudobulk profiles
keep <- pb_meta$cluster %in% c("1","2")
pb_counts_sub <- pb_counts[, keep, drop = FALSE]
pb_meta_sub   <- pb_meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]

# (optional but recommended) Filter weakly expressed genes
# Use edgeR::filterByExpr if you like; here a simple guard:
gene_keep <- rowSums(pb_counts_sub) >= 10
pb_counts_sub <- pb_counts_sub[gene_keep, , drop = FALSE]

# 5) Bulk-style DE with donor as replicate and cluster as condition
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(pb_counts_sub),  # should already be integer
  colData   = pb_meta_sub,
  design    = ~ sample_id + cluster
)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("cluster", "1", "2"))  # 1 vs 2
res <- as.data.frame(res)
res$geneID=rownames(res)
res=res%>%mutate(q_value = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
                 log10pvalue = -log10(pvalue),
                 log10qvalue = -log10(q_value),
                 treshold_col=ifelse(log2FoldChange > 1 & pvalue < 0.05, "up",
                        ifelse(log2FoldChange < -1 & pvalue < 0.05, "down", "other")),
                 to_show_col=ifelse(pvalue < 0.02, geneID, ""))
res$log2FoldChange[is.infinite(res$log2FoldChange)] <- NA


ggplot(data = res, aes(x =log2FoldChange, y = log10pvalue)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = as.factor(treshold_col)), size = 1.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("up" = "red", "down" = "blue", "other" = "grey")) +
     ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  data = res %>%
    filter(pvalue < 0.05 ),
  aes(label = (to_show_col)),
  size = 3,
  box.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
  point.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
  segment.color = "grey",
  segment.size = 0.2,max.overlaps =100
)+
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = (log10(0.05) * -1),linetype="dotted") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(fc_level, fc_level2),linetype="dotted") +
   # xlim(c(-100, 80)) + ylim(c(0, 350)) +
    xlab("log2 fold change") + ylab("-Log10 adj p-value")#+
 # annotate("text", x = -60, y = 350, label = paste("comparison cl ", i), col = "black", size = 4, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot, "_cl", i, ".pdf"),
    plot = volcano_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
```
